rules.name: CVE-2026-34486 — Tomcat Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-34486: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.. Product: Tomcat
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-34486" or Message contains "TOMCAT" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3

rules.name: CVE-2016-3081 — Struts Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2016-3081: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.. Product: Struts
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2016-3081" or RuleName has "CVE-2016-3081" or ProcessName has "CVE-2016-3081" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WEB-APPLICATION-002
